## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put all three bottles, the yellow bottle with elongated cylinder body, the bottle with blue highlights, and the plastic bottle with ridges near bottom, into the simple black garbage bin.

Task description: Put the slender yellow bottle on the table, the bottle with blue decoration, and the dark red-labeled plastic bottle with a ridged bottom into the black trash bin on the left side of the table.

Success criteria: All three bottles must be within the black bin's interior storage region, below the tabletop but still some distance above the ground. Merely moving them above the opening or dropping them on the ground outside does not count.

## Execution tips

- Choose the upper-middle of the yellow bottle's long straight section, the straight body near the blue bottle's blue decoration, and the straight label-covered section of the red-labeled bottle. Avoid shoulders and uneven bottoms so both pads make full contact.
- Open slightly wider than the chosen bottle section and approach from the side with more space from its neighbor. Confirm the fingers actually straddle the body before closing rather than relying on image overlap and toppling it.
- When carrying the bottle toward the trash bin on the left, keep its base above objects on the table and the table edge. Reorient the bottle in an open area to reduce the risk of its lower end brushing objects or slipping.
- Only part of the black bin opening is visible initially. Use live side views to confirm its boundary and aim the bottle bottom toward free space inside. Release well inside the opening while maintaining finger clearance from the rim to reduce impacts, bounce-outs, or obstruction by bottles already inside.
